title: Finite-level exchange rectangle
statement:
For every $n$, the diagram
$$
 \begin{array}{ccc}
  A_n&\xrightarrow{h_n}&B_n\\
  v_n\downarrow&&\downarrow v'_n\\
  C_n&\xrightarrow{h'_n}&D_n
 \end{array}
$$
commutes. Equivalently, $v'_nh_n=h'_nv_n$.

note:
*Source:* the commutativity is Stacks Project, Cohomology on Sites, Remark
21.50.2 ([Tag 0E48](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0E48)): the
projection-formula map (21.50.0.1, [Tag
0B56](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0B56)) is compatible with the
base change map of Remark 21.19.3 ([Tag
07A7](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07A7)), i.e. for a commutative
diagram of ringed topoi and $E\in D(\mathcal O_{\mathcal C})$,
$K\in D(\mathcal O_{\mathcal D})$ the square formed by
$Lg^*(Rf_*E\otimes^LK)\to Lg^*Rf_*(E\otimes^LLf^*K)$ (projection formula),
$Lg^*(Rf_*E\otimes^LK)\to Lg^*Rf_*E\otimes^LLg^*K$ (base change),
$Rf'_*L(g')^*E\otimes^LLg^*K\to Rf'_*(L(g')^*E\otimes^LL(f')^*Lg^*K)$
(projection formula) and
$Lg^*Rf_*(E\otimes^LLf^*K)\to Rf'_*L(g')^*(E\otimes^LLf^*K)$ (base change)
commutes; this is exactly the rectangle $v'_nh_n=h'_nv_n$ at the level of
the four corners of [def-weil-pbc-four-corners]. Difference of generality:
Stacks states the commutativity for arbitrary $E,K$ over ringed topoi, with
no completeness hypothesis, no coefficient tower and no finite coefficient
ring, and omits the verification ("we omit the verification"); the rectangle
is the finite-level instance at the perfect coefficient $P_n=A/I^n$ of the
adic coefficient datum, and it is this finite-level form that the completed
exchange below reduces to.

proof.text: Fix an index $n\geq1$ of the adic tower and use the Cartesian square and complex $K$ of [def-weil-pbc-four-corners]. Write $E=Lg'^*K$, $K_n=K\otimes_A^LP_n$, and use the specified identification $E_n\simeq E\otimes_A^LP_n$. By [def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], $P_n=A/I^n$ is perfect, and its pullback to $Y' is the corresponding perfect finite coefficient object. By [def-weil-pbc-four-arrows], $h_n=Lg_n^*\pi_{f,K,P_n}$ and $h'_n=\pi_{f',E,P_n}$ on these corners. The isomorphism assertion in [lemma-weil-pbc-perfect-projection-formula], applied to $(f,K)$ and $(f',E)$, gives these horizontal isomorphisms. The same arrow definition specifies $v_n$ as $\operatorname{Ex}^A_K\otimes^L1_{P_n}$ preceded by the canonical identification $A_n\simeq(Lg^*Rf_*K)\otimes_A^LP_n$, and specifies $v'_n$ as the canonical finite-coefficient exchange map $\operatorname{Ex}_{\square,K_n}$; the etale-origin witness supplies its invertibility. Thus the vertical arrows are the specified exchange maps, not arbitrary isomorphisms witnessing proper base change.

proof.text: Apply the Cartesian-square clause of [lemma-weil-pbc-projection-formula-base-change-naturality] with its complex $K$ equal to the present $K$ and its coefficient $Q=P_n$. Use [def-weil-pbc-ambient-ringed-exchange] for the canonical exchange transformation and [def-weil-pbc-four-corners] to identify the two targets by $Lg'^*K_n=E_n\simeq E\otimes_A^LP_n$, and [def-weil-pbc-four-arrows] to identify the arrows, in particular the witness-transported $v'_n$ with the same canonical $\operatorname{Ex}_{\square,K_n}$. Its first route is $A_n\xrightarrow{Lg_n^*\pi_{f,K,P_n}}B_n\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}_{K_n}}D_n$, hence is $v'_nh_n$. Its second route is $A_n\xrightarrow{\sim}(Lg^*Rf_*K)\otimes_A^LP_n\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}^A_K\otimes1}(Rf'_*E)\otimes_A^LP_n=C_n\xrightarrow{\pi_{f',E,P_n}}D_n$, hence is $h'_nv_n$. The cited equality of these routes proves $v'_nh_n=h'_nv_n$. All target identifications here are the ones fixed in the corner and arrow definitions; no separate choice of a finite-level base-change isomorphism is made.

proof.text:
The two routes around the rectangle are both the level-$n$ reduction of the
base-change mate, computed through the projection-formula isomorphisms on
the two sides; naturality of the perfect-coefficient projection-formula map
with respect to the base-change mate makes them equal, with the arrows of
[def-weil-pbc-four-arrows].
